source: Named titled grandmaster positions: original 160 training games plus verified additional unique source games
lookup: Exact EPD key; named-GM moves only; count-weighted bounded search preference
safety: Legal moves only; compare with alpha-beta search, prefer memory only within 20 centipawns of searched best score; no automatic candidate weight approval
limitation: Exact-position recall; no claim of increased playing strength without matched chess tournaments.
selection: 400 entirely new titled-GM games; exclude prior 200 (including 40 holdout), original 1000-book games and prior expansions
